TRAVEL INSURANCE POLICY WORDING
Issued by Meridian Travel Insurance Ltd

1. Definitions
1.1. Dental treatment means treatment of the teeth or gums.
1.2. Family means your spouse or partner and any children who live with you.
1.3. Hazardous activity means skydiving, motor racing, or trekking or climbing above 3,000 metres.
1.4. Physiotherapy means treatment of muscles and joints by a physiotherapist.
1.5. Policy period means twelve months from the policy start date shown in your schedule.
1.6. Pre-existing condition means any illness or injury for which you received treatment or advice in the 6 months before the policy start date.
1.7. Sports equipment means skis, snowboards, golf clubs, surfboards and bicycles.
1.8. Travelling companion means a person who has booked to travel with you on the same trip.
1.9. Valuables means laptops, tablets, mobile phones, cameras, watches and jewellery.

2. Limits and excess
2.1. Baggage and Personal Belongings: limit $3,000 per incident; excess $100 per claim.
2.2. Emergency Medical Expenses: limit $50,000 per incident; excess $150 per claim.
2.3. Trip Cancellation: limit $2,000 per incident; excess $100 per claim.
2.4. Travel Delay: limit $500 per incident; excess $50 per claim.
2.5. The excess is deducted from the assessed loss before any limit or sublimit is applied.

3. Emergency Medical Expenses
3.1. We will pay reasonable and necessary emergency medical costs incurred during the trip.
3.2. The most we will pay for Dental treatment under this section is $400 per incident.
3.3. The most we will pay for Physiotherapy under this section is $500 per incident.
3.4. We will not pay for treatment of a pre-existing condition.
3.5. We will not pay for injury or illness arising from a hazardous activity. This exclusion does not apply if the Adventure Sports extension is shown in your schedule.
3.6. We will not pay for any claim arising from your being under the influence of alcohol or drugs.

4. Baggage and Personal Belongings
4.1. We will pay for the loss of, theft of, or damage to your baggage and personal belongings during the trip.
4.2. The most we will pay for Valuables under this section is $250 per incident.
4.3. The most we will pay for Sports equipment under this section is $300 per incident.
4.4. We will not pay for loss or theft of property left unattended in a vehicle or in a public place. This exclusion does not apply to property locked out of sight in the boot or trunk of a locked vehicle.
4.5. We will not pay for loss caused by confiscation or detention by customs or other officials.
4.6. We will not pay for damage caused by wear and tear or gradual deterioration.

5. General exclusions
5.1. We will not pay for loss caused by nuclear radiation or radioactive contamination.
5.2. We will not pay for any deliberate or criminal act by you.

6. Making a claim
6.1. You must notify us of a claim within 14 days of the incident. We will not pay any claim notified after that time.
6.2. We may appoint a loss adjuster to investigate any claim.
6.3. You must provide proof of ownership or of the cost incurred for every item or service claimed.

7. Repatriation
7.1. If our medical adviser agrees it is necessary, we will arrange and pay for you to be brought home.
7.2. We will decide the method of transport and the time of repatriation after speaking to the treating doctor.

8. Electronic documents
8.1. We will send documents by email unless you ask for paper copies.
8.2. You must tell us if your email address changes.
8.3. Documents sent by email are treated as received on the day they are sent.

9. Environmental commitment
9.1. Where practical, we will repair rather than replace damaged items and will use recycled or refurbished parts.
9.2. You may ask for a new part instead, and we will tell you whether any additional cost would apply.

10. Arbitration
10.1. If we accept a claim but disagree with you about the amount, the difference will be referred to an arbitrator appointed by both parties.
10.2. Where arbitration applies, obtaining an award is a condition precedent to any legal action against us.

11. Reasonable precautions
11.1. You must take all reasonable steps to prevent loss or damage and to keep property in good condition.
11.2. You must take reasonable steps to recover lost or stolen property.

12. Payment of claims
12.1. We will pay claims by bank transfer to an account in your name.
12.2. We aim to pay accepted claims within 5 working days of receiving all the documents we need.

13. Assignment
13.1. You cannot transfer your interest in this policy to anyone else without our written consent.

14. Instalment agreements
14.1. If you pay by instalments, the instalment agreement is a separate contract with the finance provider.
14.2. Ending the instalment agreement does not cancel this policy, but unpaid premium remains due.

31.1. We will not pay for loss caused by nuclear radiation or radioactive contamination.
31.2. We will not pay for loss or damage caused by war, invasion, or civil war.
31.3. We will not pay for any fraudulent claim or any claim supported by false documents.
31.4. We will not pay for loss arising from a government order or sanction that prohibits us from paying.

32.2. After the first 14 days you can cancel at any time; we will refund the premium for the unexpired period less an administration charge of $30.

34.1. A person who is not a party to this policy has no right to enforce any of its terms.

35. Making a claim
35.1. You must provide proof of ownership or of the cost incurred for every item or service claimed.

36.1. If you pay by instalments, the instalment agreement is a separate contract with the finance provider.

4.1. You must take all reasonable steps to prevent loss or damage and to keep property in good condition.
4.2. You must take reasonable steps to recover lost or stolen property.

5. Discounts
5.1. Any discount shown in the schedule applies only while the conditions for it continue to be met.
5.2. If a condition for a discount stops being met, we may charge the premium without the discount from that date.

6. Notices

6.2. Notices from you should be sent to the address shown in the schedule.

7. Contracts (Rights of Third Parties)
7.1. A person who is not a party to this policy has no right to enforce any of its terms.

8. How to read this document
8.1. This document, the schedule and any endorsements form one contract and should be read together.
8.2. Where the schedule and this document conflict, the schedule applies.
8.3. Examples given in this document are for illustration only and do not limit the meaning of any term.

9. Instalment agreements
9.1. If you pay by instalments, the instalment agreement is a separate contract with the finance provider.
9.2. Ending the instalment agreement does not cancel this policy, but unpaid premium remains due.

10. Dental Care
10.1. We will reimburse the cost of dental treatment provided by a licensed dentist.
10.2. No cover applies under this section to any treatment that happens within the first 90 days after the policy start date.
10.3. The most we will pay for Major restorative work under this section is $750 per treatment.
10.4. The most we will pay for Orthodontics under this section is $800 per treatment.
10.5. We will not pay for treatment that is mainly cosmetic, such as whitening or veneers. This exclusion does not apply to treatment needed to repair damage caused by an accident.
10.6. We will not pay for treatment by a provider outside the plan's network. This exclusion does not apply to emergency treatment for sudden severe pain.

11. Severability
11.1. If any term of this policy is found to be invalid, the remaining terms will continue in full force.

12. Coordination of benefits
12.1. If a treatment is also covered by another plan, we will pay only the part of the cost that the other plan does not pay.
12.2. You must tell us about any other plan that covers you or your dependants.

13. Payment of claims
13.1. We will pay claims by bank transfer to an account in your name.
13.2. We aim to pay accepted claims within 5 working days of receiving all the documents we need.

14. Leaving the plan
14.1. Cover ends on the day your employment ends or the day you stop being eligible, whichever is earlier.
14.2. Claims for treatment received before cover ended may be submitted up to 90 days afterwards.

15. Recovery of costs
15.1. If we pay a claim that is later found not to be covered, we may ask you to repay the amount.

16. Third-party administrators
16.1. We may appoint another company to handle claims or other services on our behalf.
16.2. Any company we appoint must follow the terms of this policy and applicable data protection law.

17. Duty of fair presentation
17.1. You must answer all questions we ask honestly and to the best of your knowledge.
17.2. If you give incorrect information deliberately or recklessly, we may treat this policy as if it never existed and keep the premium.
17.3. If you give incorrect information carelessly, we may reduce any claim payment in proportion to the premium that should have been charged.

18. Wellness allowance
18.1. Each plan year you may claim up to $150 towards a gym membership or fitness class.
18.2. The wellness allowance is not subject to any deductible and does not count towards other limits.

19. Vision Care
19.1. We will reimburse eye tests and prescription eyewear.
19.2. The most we will pay for Frames under this section is $150 per treatment.
19.3. We will not pay for eyewear without prescription lenses.
19.4. We will not pay for a further eyewear claim within the replacement period.

20. Appeals
20.1. If we decline all or part of a claim, you may appeal in writing within 60 days of the decision.
20.2. An appeal will be reviewed by someone who was not involved in the original decision.
20.3. We will give you a written decision on the appeal within 30 days.

21. Other insurance
21.1. If any loss covered by this policy is also covered by another policy, we will pay only our proportionate share.
21.2. You must tell us about any other insurance that covers the same loss when you make a claim.

22. Interest
22.1. We will not pay interest on any claim payment unless the law requires it.

23. Currency
23.1. All amounts in this policy are in US dollars.
23.2. Claims for costs incurred in another currency will be converted at the exchange rate on the date the cost was incurred.

24. Data protection
24.1. We will use the personal information you provide to administer this policy and to handle claims.
24.2. We will keep personal information only for as long as it is needed for these purposes or as required by law.
24.3. You can ask for a copy of the personal information we hold by writing to our data protection officer.

25. Therapy Services
25.1. We will reimburse physiotherapy, osteopathy and counselling provided by a registered practitioner.
25.2. The most we will pay for Massage therapy under this section is $200 per treatment.
25.3. We will not pay for treatment of an injury covered by workers' compensation.
25.4. We will not pay for treatment by a practitioner who is not registered with the relevant professional body.

26. Exchange of information
26.1. To prevent fraud, we may check the details you give against public records and industry databases.
26.2. We may contact previous insurers to confirm your claims history.

27. Joint policyholders
27.1. Where more than one person is named in the schedule, each of them is treated as having knowledge of anything any of them knows.
27.2. A notice sent to one named person is treated as sent to all of them.

28. General exclusions
28.1. We will not pay for loss or damage caused by war, invasion, or civil war.
28.2. We will not pay for loss arising from a government order or sanction that prohibits us from paying.
28.3. We will not pay for any fraudulent claim or any claim supported by false documents.
28.4. We will not pay for any deliberate or criminal act by you.
28.5. We will not pay for loss caused by nuclear radiation or radioactive contamination.

29. Cooperation
29.1. You must give us all the help and information we reasonably need to settle a claim.
29.2. You must not admit liability or offer to settle any claim without our written permission.

30. Inflation
30.1. We may adjust limits at renewal in line with a published index of consumer prices.
30.2. Any adjustment will be shown in your renewal documents; limits do not change during a policy period.

31. Eligibility
31.1. Employees who work at least 20 hours a week are eligible to join the plan from their first day of employment.
31.2. Contractors, agency workers and employees on unpaid leave of more than three months are not eligible.

32. Waiver
32.1. If we do not enforce any term of this policy, that does not mean we have given up the right to enforce it later.

33. Automatic renewal
33.1. Unless you tell us otherwise, this policy will renew automatically at the end of the policy period using the payment details we hold.
33.2. You can switch off automatic renewal at any time by contacting our helpline.

34. Making a claim
34.1. You must provide proof of ownership or of the cost incurred for every item or service claimed.
34.2. You must notify us of a claim within 14 days of the treatment. We will not pay any claim notified after that time.
34.3. We may appoint a loss adjuster to investigate any claim.

35. Arbitration
35.1. If we accept a claim but disagree with you about the amount, the difference will be referred to an arbitrator appointed by both parties.
35.2. Where arbitration applies, obtaining an award is a condition precedent to any legal action against us.

36. Renewal
36.1. We will write to you at least 21 days before the end of the policy period with the renewal terms.
36.2. We are not obliged to offer renewal.

37. Geographical limits
37.1. Cover applies only within the territory shown in the schedule.
37.2. Cover for property temporarily away from its usual place applies only within the same country.

38. Electronic documents
38.1. We will send documents by email unless you ask for paper copies.
38.2. You must tell us if your email address changes.
38.3. Documents sent by email are treated as received on the day they are sent.

39. Taxes
39.1. The premium includes any insurance premium tax at the current rate.

HOME CONTENTS INSURANCE POLICY
Issued by Keystone Home Mutual

1. Definitions
1.1. Art and antiques means paintings, antiques, rugs and other works of art.
1.2. Family means your spouse or partner and any children who live with you.
1.3. Garden items means garden furniture, plants and outdoor tools.
1.4. Portable electronics means laptops, tablets and mobile phones.
1.5. Sublimit means a lower limit that applies to a particular class of property or treatment within a section.

2. Limits and excess
2.1. Theft: limit $40,000 per incident; excess $100 per claim.
2.2. Escape of Water: limit $15,000 per incident; excess $500 per claim.
2.3. Accidental Damage: limit $3,000 per incident; excess $50 per claim.
2.4. Flood: limit $20,000 per incident; excess $500 per claim.
2.5. The excess is deducted from the assessed loss before any limit or sublimit is applied.

3. Escape of Water
3.1. We will pay for contents damaged by water escaping from a fixed pipe, tank or domestic appliance.
3.2. The most we will pay for Art and antiques under this section is $2,000 per incident.
3.3. We will not pay for damage caused by water leaking gradually over a period of time.
3.4. We will not pay for damage caused by the failure of grout or sealant around baths and showers.

4. Flood
4.1. We will pay for contents damaged by flood water entering your home.
4.2. No cover applies under this section to any incident that happens within the first 30 days after the policy start date.
4.3. The most we will pay for Garden items under this section is $500 per incident.
4.4. We will not pay for flood damage where a flood warning for your area had been issued before the policy started.

5. Optional cover: Accidental Damage
5.1. We will pay for sudden and unexpected accidental damage to your contents inside the home.
5.2. This section applies only if it is shown as purchased in your schedule.
5.3. The most we will pay for Portable electronics under this section is $750 per incident.
5.4. We will not pay for damage caused by pets.
5.5. We will not pay for wear and tear, or damage that happens gradually.

6. General exclusions
6.1. We will not pay for loss caused by nuclear radiation or radioactive contamination.
6.2. We will not pay for loss or damage caused by war, invasion, or civil war.

7. Making a claim
7.1. You must notify us of a claim within 21 days of the incident. We will not pay any claim notified after that time.
7.2. We may appoint a loss adjuster to investigate any claim.
7.3. You must provide proof of ownership or of the cost incurred for every item or service claimed.

8. Recovery of costs
8.1. If we pay a claim that is later found not to be covered, we may ask you to repay the amount.

9. Locks and keys
9.1. If the keys to your home are lost or stolen, we will pay the cost of replacing the locks to the outside doors.
9.2. The most we will pay under this clause is $300 for any one claim.

10. Reasonable precautions
10.1. You must take all reasonable steps to prevent loss or damage and to keep property in good condition.
10.2. You must take reasonable steps to recover lost or stolen property.

11. Other insurance
11.1. If any loss covered by this policy is also covered by another policy, we will pay only our proportionate share.
11.2. You must tell us about any other insurance that covers the same loss when you make a claim.

12. Cooperation
12.1. You must give us all the help and information we reasonably need to settle a claim.
12.2. You must not admit liability or offer to settle any claim without our written permission.

13. Governing law
13.1. This policy is governed by the law of the jurisdiction in which it was issued, unless both parties agree otherwise in writing.
13.2. Any dispute will be subject to the exclusive jurisdiction of the courts of that jurisdiction.

14. Fraud
14.1. If any claim is fraudulent or exaggerated in any respect, we will not pay the claim and all cover under this policy may be cancelled.
14.2. We may share information with fraud prevention agencies and other insurers.

15. Automatic renewal
15.1. Unless you tell us otherwise, this policy will renew automatically at the end of the policy period using the payment details we hold.
15.2. You can switch off automatic renewal at any time by contacting our helpline.

16. Environmental commitment
16.1. Where practical, we will repair rather than replace damaged items and will use recycled or refurbished parts.
16.2. You may ask for a new part instead, and we will tell you whether any additional cost would apply.

17. Claims documents
17.1. You must provide, at your own expense, original receipts, invoices, reports and any other evidence we reasonably ask for.
17.2. We may ask for a medical certificate, a police report or a repair estimate, depending on the claim.

9. Customer support
9.1. Our helpline is open from 8 a.m. to 8 p.m. on weekdays and from 9 a.m. to 5 p.m. on Saturdays.
9.2. Outside these hours you can leave a message and we will call back on the next working day.

10. Dental Care
10.1. We will reimburse the cost of dental treatment provided by a licensed dentist.
10.2. No cover applies under this section to any treatment that happens within the first 60 days after the policy start date.
10.3. The most we will pay for Major restorative work under this section is $500 per treatment.
10.4. The most we will pay for Orthodontics under this section is $600 per treatment.
10.5. We will not pay for treatment that is mainly cosmetic, such as whitening or veneers. This exclusion does not apply to treatment needed to repair damage caused by an accident.
10.6. We will not pay for treatment by a provider outside the plan's network. This exclusion does not apply to emergency treatment for sudden severe pain.

11. Third-party administrators
11.1. We may appoint another company to handle claims or other services on our behalf.
11.2. Any company we appoint must follow the terms of this policy and applicable data protection law.

12. Waiver
12.1. If we do not enforce any term of this policy, that does not mean we have given up the right to enforce it later.

13. Subrogation
13.1. We will be entitled to take over and conduct in your name the defence or settlement of any claim.
13.2. We can take action in your name to recover any payment we make from anyone responsible for the loss.

14. Appeals
14.1. If we decline all or part of a claim, you may appeal in writing within 60 days of the decision.
14.2. An appeal will be reviewed by someone who was not involved in the original decision.
14.3. We will give you a written decision on the appeal within 30 days.

15. Cooperation
15.1. You must give us all the help and information we reasonably need to settle a claim.
15.2. You must not admit liability or offer to settle any claim without our written permission.

16. Compensation scheme
16.1. We are covered by a financial services compensation scheme.
16.2. If we cannot meet our obligations, you may be entitled to compensation from the scheme, depending on the type of policy and the circumstances.

17. Optional cover: Hearing Care
17.1. We will reimburse hearing tests and hearing aids.
17.2. This section applies only if it is shown as purchased in your schedule.
17.3. The most we will pay for Hearing accessories under this section is $150 per treatment.
17.4. We will not pay for replacement hearing aids bought within the hearing aid replacement period.

18. Renewal
18.1. We will write to you at least 21 days before the end of the policy period with the renewal terms.
18.2. We are not obliged to offer renewal.

19. Electronic documents
19.1. We will send documents by email unless you ask for paper copies.
19.2. You must tell us if your email address changes.
19.3. Documents sent by email are treated as received on the day they are sent.

20. How to read this document
20.1. This document, the schedule and any endorsements form one contract and should be read together.
20.2. Where the schedule and this document conflict, the schedule applies.
20.3. Examples given in this document are for illustration only and do not limit the meaning of any term.

21. Notices
21.1. Any notice we give under this policy will be sent to the most recent postal or email address we hold.
21.2. Notices from you should be sent to the address shown in the schedule.

22. Therapy Services
22.1. We will reimburse physiotherapy, osteopathy and counselling provided by a registered practitioner.
22.2. The most we will pay for Massage therapy under this section is $300 per treatment.
22.3. We will not pay for treatment of an injury covered by workers' compensation.
22.4. We will not pay for treatment by a practitioner who is not registered with the relevant professional body.

23. Vision Care
23.1. We will reimburse eye tests and prescription eyewear.
23.2. The most we will pay for Frames under this section is $120 per treatment.
23.3. We will not pay for eyewear without prescription lenses.
23.4. We will not pay for a further eyewear claim within the replacement period.

24. Payment of claims
24.1. We will pay claims by bank transfer to an account in your name.
24.2. We aim to pay accepted claims within 10 working days of receiving all the documents we need.

25. General exclusions
25.1. We will not pay for any fraudulent claim or any claim supported by false documents.
25.2. We will not pay for loss caused by nuclear radiation or radioactive contamination.
25.3. We will not pay for loss or damage caused by war, invasion, or civil war.

26. Making a claim
26.1. We may appoint a loss adjuster to investigate any claim.
26.2. You must provide proof of ownership or of the cost incurred for every item or service claimed.
26.3. You must notify us of a claim within 21 days of the treatment. We will not pay any claim notified after that time.

27. Severability
27.1. If any term of this policy is found to be invalid, the remaining terms will continue in full force.

28. Fraud
28.1. If any claim is fraudulent or exaggerated in any respect, we will not pay the claim and all cover under this policy may be cancelled.
28.2. We may share information with fraud prevention agencies and other insurers.

29. Changes in circumstances
29.1. You must tell us as soon as reasonably possible about any change in the information shown in the schedule.
29.2. We may then change the premium or the terms of this policy, or cancel it.

30. Cancellation
30.1. You can cancel this policy within 14 days of receiving it and receive a full refund, provided no claim has been made.
30.2. After the first 14 days you can cancel at any time; we will refund the premium for the unexpired period less an administration charge of $30.
30.3. We can cancel this policy by giving you 30 days' written notice to the last address we hold.

31. Change of address
31.1. You must tell us within 30 days if you change your address.
31.2. We may change the premium or the terms from the date of the move.
